definitions.cyclic_locus: CV_q={v in R_q^2: Delta_q(v) is a unit}
definitions.global_integral_centralizer: Cent_GL2(Z)(A), whose reductions land in but are not identified with the full local C_q
definitions.local_pseudo_symmetry_cost: the quotient uses every modulo-q commuter in C_q and does not require one fixed global lift
definitions.prime_reversing_group: R_p(A)={G in GL2(F_p): G*A*G^(-1)=A^(+1 or -1)}=C_p union J*C_p

frozen_theorem_claims: T1: e1 is cyclic over R_q for every q>=2.
T2: Cent_Mat2(R_q)(A)=R_q[A] and Cent_GL2(R_q)(A)=R_q[A]^times for every q>=2.
T3: U->U*e1 is a C_q-equivariant bijection from C_q to CV_q, so CV_q is a C_q torsor and is contained in E_q.
T4: every A-orbit on CV_q has length ord_q(A), and Gamma_q^cyc is C_q/<A> with size |C_q|/ord_q(A).
T5: the residual centralizer quotient of Gamma_q^cyc and the direct quotient CV_q/C_q each have one class.
T6: since A lies in C_q, the induced A map on CV_q/C_q is the identity with native primitive period one, independent of q.
T7: determinant on C_q is the norm N_q of S_q, and CV_q/C_q^1 is im(N_q) via Delta_q.
T8: |im(N_q)|=phi(q) if 5 does not divide q and phi(q)/2 if 5 divides q.
T9: the induced A map on CV_q/C_q^1 is also the identity because A lies in C_q^1.
T10: at inert or binary primes CV_p is the full nonzero shell and C_p has one shell orbit.
T11: at split p not equal to 5, CV_p has (p-1)^2 points, discards two punctured eigenlines, and the full shell has three C_p orbits.
T12: at p=5, CV_5 has 20 points, discards the four nonzero Jordan-eigenline vectors, and the full shell has two C_5 orbits.
T13: the prime reversing group can merge the two split eigenlines but cannot merge cyclic and noncyclic strata.
T14: |CV_q| is the CRT product of p^(2(k-1))*c_p with c_p fixed by binary/inert, split, or ramified type.
T15: the one-class full-centralizer quotient exists for every composite q>=2 as well as primes.
T16: assigning (1-q^(-s))^(-1) to the class requires the external specialization z=q^(-s); the quotient dynamics supplies neither log(q) nor a prime selector.
T17: the terminal result is A0 failure; A2-A4 and Route B remain closed.

centralizer_torsor_lock.torsor_inverse: write v uniquely as a*e1+b*A*e1 and return a*I+b*A
centralizer_torsor_lock.cyclic_exact_order_reason: a cyclic vector belongs to an R_q basis, hence is unimodular and has exact additive order q
centralizer_torsor_lock.local_group_scope: C_q is q-dependent and no equality with the reduction image of the global integral centralizer is assumed

quotient_dynamics_lock.residual_action: C_q/<A> acts simply transitively on the A-orbit set

symplectic_norm_lock.symplectic_orbits: the fibers of Delta_q on CV_q
symplectic_norm_lock.norm_image_if_5_divides_q: units whose residue modulo 5 is a square in the 5-primary component

prime_strata_lock.reversing_boundary: the fixed reversor may merge split eigenlines but the prime reversing group never mixes CV_p with its complement in the frozen cases
three_layers: C_p: full q-local GL commuting centralizer
R_p(A): commuting and reversing local symmetry group

composite_formula_lock.exact_order_shell_size: J_2(q)=q^2*product over prime p dividing q of (1-p^(-2))
composite_formula_lock.cyclic_locus_size: product over p^k exactly dividing q of p^(2*(k-1))*c_p

composite_rationale.6: squarefree binary and odd-inert CRT product
